**Verdict: CONFIRMED.** Both lines are unchanged since filing. Doc and changeset hygiene only, with no runtime effect.

- (a) `packages/types/src/data-display.ts:1383` still says 「`ObjectDataTable` passes `schema.onRowClick ?? handleRowClick`」. The code at `plugin-dashboard/src/ObjectDataTable.tsx:1043` is `schema.onRowClick ?? (recordDrillEnabled ? handleRowClick : undefined)`, so the paraphrase drops the `recordDrillEnabled` gate. Lit control: the sibling doc at `objectql.ts:4572` quotes the line whole.
- (b) `.changeset/9462-row-click-modifier-payload-forward.md:35-37` still says `ObjectDataTableSchema.onRowClick` is 「still declaring one parameter … reported separately」. That is stale: `objectql.ts:4592` now declares `onRowClick?: (row: any, event?: any) => void` (widened by objectui#9799, see `:4567`).
- ⚠️ Time-sensitive: the changeset has not been consumed yet, so the stale sentence is frozen into the CHANGELOG at the next release.
- Fix surface: those two files. Text only, `Clause-②: no`. Size S.
